overlay_updates.official_update_note: FAGG section 13a applies from 1 October 2026 to new contracts, requiring a prominent electronic withdrawal function, confirmation step and immediate durable acknowledgement. Publishing policy text alone does not implement this website function.

legal_version: Consumer Protection Act chapter 6 section 12c, Law 835/2026 (effective 2026-10-01)

overlay_updates.national_product_marketing_clause: For sales to Finland, environmental claims must be accurate and substantiated under sections 6a-6b of the Consumer Protection Act as amended by Law 573/2026. If an online customer selects a deferred-payment method, the applicable strong identity-verification requirements under chapter 6 section 12c must be satisfied before concluding the contract. This statement does not itself implement identity verification.
